text:
Which statements about the metal zinc are correct?
1
It is extracted from the ore bauxite.
2
It is used to galvanise steel.
3
It is used to make the alloy brass.
4
It reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to produce hydrogen gas.
A
1, 2 and 4
B
1, 3 and 4
C
2, 3 and 4
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
